answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a pigment bet on surviving 40 epochs of grading, and every jetty settlement recomputes the nadir schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 40 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 33 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
